'''Thaddeus Chenoweth''' finished 9th at the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dec-sun">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/gameresults2.html Sunday semi-final results], Decipher (7 December 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990427191534/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/gameresults2.html Internet Archive]</ref> He was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 50 from Colorado Springs, Co. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

== 1997 World Championship statement ==

"I'm 25, and live in Colorado Springs. My favorite pastimes are playing racquetball and Star Wars CCG. I enjoy teaching people how to play Star Wars CCG and helping Decipher as a Squadron member, Gold 50. My favorite movies are Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back, Braveheart, and now, Starship Troopers! My two favorite Star Wars CCG cards are Gold Leader in Gold 1 and Tonnika Sisters (just for looks)."<ref name="dec97bio">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/chenoweth.html Thaddeus Chenoweth], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990427150716/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/chenoweth.html Internet Archive]</ref>

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables; the tables do not spell out the abbreviation.
